Low Country Suite

Dana Ruiz · gouache series, 2026

She paints entire American road trips from memory — no reference photos

Portland-based illustrator Dana Ruiz builds every landscape from what she calls "muscle memory of light." Her latest series has sold out three gallery runs this year, and she still works entirely with gouache.

By Nora Kessler · Artist Spotlights

"A painting doesn't need to explain itself. It just needs to hold your eye long enough to change how you see the next thing."
